open_questions_for_vendor: Please confirm the exact legal entity (full name, legal form, and state/country of incorporation) that contracts with Tavus, Inc. — is it fal – Features & Labels, Inc., and where is it registered? Please also provide your principal place of business (2261 Market St. Suite 10467, San Francisco appears to be a mailbox-style address).

As a US company processing EU data subjects' personal data: have you designated an EU representative under Article 27 GDPR? If yes, please provide the representative's name and full address; if no, please state the basis on which Article 27 does not apply to you.

Have you appointed a data protection officer? If yes, please provide the DPO's name, telephone number, and email address; if no, please confirm in writing that support@fal.ai is the authoritative contact entitled to respond to data-protection-related requests (SAP requires a named channel).

Is your current SOC 2 attestation Type I or Type II, what is the report period and auditor, and can you provide the report under NDA? Your careers materials reference compliance programs 'including SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and ISO 27001' — which of these are completed certifications/attestations (with certificates and scope statements) versus programs in progress?
What minimum TLS version is enforced for data in transit to your API and inference endpoints, including WebSocket (real-time) connections (TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3)?
Is customer data (including video/audio media submitted for inference) encrypted at rest, and with which algorithm and key length (e.g. AES-256)?
Are backups encrypted, and with which algorithm? Do backups ever contain customer media or request payloads?
Who generates and manages the encryption keys for data at rest (platform-managed KMS, customer-specific keys, CMEK/BYOK options)?

Can fal, acting as a processor, anonymize or pseudonymize personal data (including video/audio frames processed during inference) on the customer's instruction, or is the anonymization/aggregation described in your Privacy Policy and Terms of Service limited to fal's own 'Usage Data' purposes?

Your Terms of Service define 'Usage Data' as anonymized or aggregated data that 'may include data based on or derived from Customer Input' and reserve rights to use it to 'design, develop, and offer products, services, and AI models'. Does Tavus's enterprise agreement/DPA exclude Customer Input (end-user video/audio) from Usage Data and from any model training or product development use?

Do you offer an EU region or EU data-residency option for inference workloads and stored data? If yes, in which country/countries, and does it cover the full processing path (ingestion, inference, logging, storage)?

For inference workloads: is customer media (video/audio frames) persisted at any point (queuing, caching, logging, persistent storage), and if so where and for how long — or is it processed in memory only?

Please provide your current sub-processor list and the underlying cloud/data-center provider(s) hosting your GPU fleet (SAP requires the processing chain to Level 2), and confirm a signed DPA with Tavus that flows down GDPR Art. 28 obligations.
